name: Demon Boy Saga
source:
A wealthy and well-established family will have an economic mishap that will change their lives for the worse.
A catastrophe for some, except for our protagonist, who will use what is coming to his advantage.
translation:
一个富裕且声望卓著的家庭遭遇经济变故，生活从此一落千丈。

这场灾难令家人们陷入困境，唯独主角打算利用即将发生的一切为自己谋利。
